in_sanskrit.name: Patidar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Chieftain, Leader
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Patidar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Patidar is a Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'pati' which means 'lord' or 'master'. The suffix 'dhar' means 'to hold' or 'to maintain'. Thus, the name Patidar translates to 'one who holds or maintains the position of a lord or chief'.
